A '''flotilla''' was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] term that denoted a group of small or medium-sized [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], mostly [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] or [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] with [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] support. Flotillas were usually commanded by an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], who administered the fighting from a specifically designated [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. The term was often used interchangeably with "[[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]," and indeed some flotillas were so large that they were fleets unto themselves.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], flotillas of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] were used to attack [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleships]]. One of the most famous engagements using this tactic was the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

When setting out to attack the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] hitherto secret [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] brought with him a massive flotilla that consisted mostly of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] from [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] along with his flagship, the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].

[[4 ABY/Legends|One year later]], the Rebel Alliance amassed a large flotilla of warships, with the various classes of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] forming the bulk of the fleet, for use in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] This formation was also bolstered by many ships donated to the cause by many of the Alliance's other constituent space navies.
